problem:
Given that $C$ and $D$ are finite, non-overlapping regions and that

$$
{∬}_{C}f(x,y)\text{ }\text{d}A=-5,\,{∬}_{D}f(x,y)\text{ }\text{d}A=7,
$$

find the value of 

$$
{∬}_{C\cup D}4f(x,y)\text{ }\text{d}A.
$$
worked_solution:
Using the linearity and additivity of double integrals, we get the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{C\cup D}4f(x,y)\text{ }\text{d}A & =4{∬}_{C\cup D}f(x,y)\text{ }\text{d}A \\  & =4({∬}_{C}f(x,y)\text{ }\text{d}A+{∬}_{D}f(x,y)\text{ }\text{d}A) \\  & =4(-5+7) \\  & =8\end{aligned}
$$
